reviews.title: Power Supply of Beauty
reviews.comment: This power supply is amazing.  It has all of the connections that your could want and is super quiet.  This power supply is perfection.
reviews.author: Kathleen R. Snyder

reviews.title: Want a Rolls Royce?
reviews.comment: Bottom Line - this is the Rolls Royce of Computer Power Supply's. 1600 Watts of pure, efficient, clean power. No, I am not an employee of be quiet!, nor do I know anyone who works there. This is just the most efficient, best-made power supply - period. We build custom computers and used them almost exclusively in the 83 units we built in 2023. And when the budget allows only the Dark Power Pro 13 versions. You should spend a few extra dollars - you will never regret doing it.
reviews.author: RFM

reviews.title: Great high powered power supply
reviews.comment: Quiet and powerful, exactly what it needs to be.  Plenty of connectors for all the internals making wire routing clean and efficient.
reviews.author: Barry

reviews.title: Future proof with confidence.
reviews.comment: One very well built PSU. Nice having the option for both 8 and 16 pin solution. This PSU is totally future proof. If gpu's require two 12 volt connectors later on, I will be ready for the upgrade with this PSU. It is also dimensionally smaller than other PSU with equivalent power specifications.
reviews.author: Ira

reviews.title: Defective Product
reviews.comment: Problem: Spontaneous system resets (think yanked out the power cord, violently) when running ComfyUI with large newer models, Topaz Video AI with 4k upscaling, DaVinci with 4k transcoding with an RTX Pro 6000 workstation card 100% of the time. Solution at the time: Reduced TDP to 80% with Afterburner, 80% of problems were gone; reduced TDP to 70% with ~400W power draw from the card, 100% of the problems were gone. AI deep scan of all forums for similar problems with similar hws WITH THIS EXACT PSU: WIDE SPREAD COMPLAINS! Permanent solution: return for refund No more German engineering/quality control - I bought into bequiet’s high-quality image, I have their case also - that could be another story, but not worth the time, but absolutely no more from them from now on.
reviews.author: W. Don
